items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: This fellow Small, Freddie Small, had the band, the guy that got me in the union.

ctx.x: No, '20, '21 maybe. '20 or '21. I got out of high school in 1921. It was before I went to Bucknell and I turned it down. I didn't want to go, but then they had a trumpet player, a piano player that had the band, I can't get all of this straight -- I have to go back a little bit. This fellow Small, Freddie Small, had the band, the guy that got me in the union.
